notes.title: BADTRIP:SURVIVAL HORROR SHOOTER
notes.notes:
Enter a world of horror and humor, discovering the 5 chapters of the game.
Be on the side of good with the character "Jack" who is lost in the middle of the dark forest and tries to survive and find his family by talking to strange things. Or be the "Wendigo" character on a mission to kidnap Jack's family to feed himself. Or be the character "Wendigo" who has the mission to kidnap Jack's family to feed himself, but this being prevented by armed enemies. Discover the abilities and mission of each character. Take on the enemies with the large number of weapons at your disposal or if you are braver with your bare fists or axes. There are no rules to follow in this horror simulator, so you decide how to play! Explore the dark forest! Challenge your skills in battle!
